0.text: I need to set up two-factor authentication (MFA)

1.text:
On your smartphone, install the Microsoft Authenticator app (App Store or Google Play).
Careful: other apps have an almost identical icon.

2.text:
On a computer, go to aka.ms/mfasetup and log in with your UNamur e-mail address and your password.
Then click "Add sign-in method".

3.text: Microsoft Authenticator is suggested by default: click "Next".

image.alt: "Start by getting the app" screen with the "Next" button

4.text: Click "Next" again: a QR code will be displayed.

image.alt: "Set up your account" screen with the "Next" button

5.text:
In the Authenticator app: tap "+", choose "Work or school account", then scan the QR code. Then click "Next" on the computer.

Doing everything on your smartphone? Click "Can't scan image?" and enter the secret key in the app.

image.alt: "Scan the QR code" screen (QR code blurred) with the "Can't scan image?" button

6.text: All set! Each time you log in, a code is shown on screen: type it into the notification you receive on your smartphone.

7.text: <contact>Contact us</contact> and give us the code below: we'll help you finish the setup.
